json.name: revenue_metrics
json.nativeDefinition:
version: 1.1
source: metric_catalog.analytics.orders
filter: "o_orderstatus = 'F'"
joins:
  - name: customer
    source: metric_catalog.analytics.customer
    on: o_custkey = c_custkey
materialization:
  schedule: every 6 hours
  mode: relaxed
dimensions:
  - name: order_date
    expr: o_orderdate
    comment: Calendar date the order was placed.
    display_name: Order Date
    synonyms: [date, day]
measures:
  - name: total_revenue
    expr: SUM(o_totalprice)
    comment: Sum of order totals in USD.
    synonyms: [revenue, sales]
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
  - name: order_count
    expr: COUNT(1)
    comment: Number of orders placed.
  - name: aov
    expr: MEASURE(total_revenue) / MEASURE(order_count)
    comment: Average order value.
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
  - name: rolling_7d
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey)
    comment: Rolling 7-day distinct order count.
    window:
      - order: order_date
        range: trailing 7 day
        semiadditive: last

fields.description: Calendar date the order was placed.

json.name: total_revenue
json.description: Sum of order totals in USD.
